answer: An agent economy can require every peer to decrypt a rotating cipher inside a deep canyon of sequential attestations before it is admitted. A sybil flood stalls because each clone must solve its own cipher, paying compute and wall-clock time. The zephyr of cheap copied identities cannot pass the gate without the secret work, so they are excluded. Marginal cost per fake identity now exceeds the tiny reward, collapsing the attack while honest agents, already verified, stay free.
